decisions.reason: Designs paste_image/paste_file names with (2),(3) suffixes chosen as the smallest unused number, reserves names within the batch and across live attachments, and scopes the rename to the paste acquisition path in add() before record creation and insertReference, explicitly keeping drop and picker real names, grounded in the fixture's add()/validateItems flow.

Names the live composer snapshot occurrences (plus in-batch reservations) as the authoritative occupied-name source and correctly explains that the records subscription deletes cache entries on any momentary empty snapshot while the composer reference is still live, matching the fixture's records.delete-on-empty-snapshot behavior.

Explains the stale chip via the captured CDN-cached tags response (x-cache HIT, age, max stable v0.2.9) combined with renderCurrentChip(tag) displaying the fetched tag, and prescribes comparing fetched tag vs running PLUGIN_VERSION semantically, showing the running version when remote is not newer and the remote tag only when genuinely newer.

Proposes concrete tests for repeated same-batch image pastes yielding distinct sequential names, a live occurrence blocking a name despite an emptied records cache, unchanged drop/picker names, an older/equal stale remote tag showing the running version, and a genuinely newer tag triggering the update chip.

Requires synchronizing package.json version with the hand-inlined PLUGIN_VERSION in the distributed lib artifact, a bundle syntax check (node --check lib/client.js), behavioral regressions, and explains delivery via package-manager/profile reinstall of the served artifact plus host restart or hard refresh, noting no host-side update endpoint exists.
